title: Influencer Marketing Agency in Colombia - AWISEE.com

facts.fact: TikTok was the favourite platform for watching creators in Colombia at 29%, ahead of Instagram and YouTube at 25% each, according to Ipsos via Portafolio (Feb 2025).
facts.quote: TikTok was the favourite platform for watching creators (29%), ahead of Instagram and YouTube (25% each).

facts.fact: The SIC's 2020 guide asks influencers to label paid content as advertising, in Spanish and as visible as the main message; it is guidance based on Colombia's consumer statute.
facts.quote: The SIC’s 2020 guide asks influencers to label paid content as advertising, in Spanish and as visible as the main message.

facts.fact: In 2023 the SIC opened investigations into companies linked to influencers, including over undisclosed commercial ties.
facts.quote: In 2023 the SIC opened investigations into companies linked to influencers, including over undisclosed commercial ties.

facts.fact: A Senate bill on content creators in Colombia would require labels such as 'Publicidad'; it passed its first debate in 2025 and is still pending.
facts.quote: A Senate bill on content creators would require labels such as “Publicidad”. It passed its first debate in 2025 and is still pending.

facts.fact: Colombia has 37.7M social media users, smaller than Brazil (150M) and Mexico (99M) but bigger than Argentina, Peru and Chile.
facts.quote: With 37.7M social media users, Colombia is smaller than Brazil (150M) and Mexico (99M) but bigger than Argentina, Peru and Chile.

facts.fact: Instagram reaches about 40% of people in both Colombia and Mexico, according to the vendor.
facts.quote: Instagram reaches about 40% of people in both Colombia and Mexico

facts.fact: AWISEE says it sends ten matched creators within 48 hours, free, after a brief.
facts.quote: Tell us your product, market and budget. We send ten matched creators within 48 hours, free.

facts.fact: AWISEE prices Colombia influencer campaigns as quoted per campaign, with a written quote sent after a short call rather than published rates.
facts.quote: Every brief is different, so we price on your goals, markets and creators, and send a written quote after a short call.
